# M3-2: Guardrails, rules, candidates

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-2`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-2`
- Depends on: M3-1b
- Touches (exclusive while running): classify/
- Plan refs: §3.2 steps 1-2, §3.3 interface and category targets, R6a, spikes/jev.md §Impact, STATE Decisions 2026-10-27
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
`classify/` holds the §3.3 types, the guardrails, the unanimous payee rules, and the candidate list drawn from the active plan's
existing categories.

## Scope
- The §3.3 types verbatim: `Txn`, `Candidate`, `Prediction`, `Model`.
- Guardrails: port from the old `categorizer/` (`git show b2414be:categorizer/categorizer.go`, with its tests). Skip transfers and
  CC payments, P2P, existing splits, unapproved rows already in `Inflow: Ready to Assign`, and locked rows. The P2P detector can't be a
  substring match on "Venmo" (§3.2): use account, payee-shape and memo signals, with fixture cases.
- Rules: a payee whose labels are unanimous across at least 3 examples (`LabeledHistory`, normalized payee) decides; the category must
  be in the active list. `Txn.PayeeHistory` uses the same data, newest first, last N, filtered to active candidates.
- Candidates (`store.CategoriesWithGroups`): the active plan's existing categories, minus deleted or hidden categories, categories in a deleted or hidden group, internal ones, `Inflow: Ready to Assign`, the `Credit Card Payments` group, and set-aside categories.
- Embedded `classify/policy.json`: excluded set-aside names (Birthday, Trip, Christmas, Giving and any like them in the plan), description
  overrides including the `Discretionary` policy. `PolicyHash` and `CandidatesHash` (sorted names + descriptions).
- A name in the policy that isn't in the plan is ignored with a warning, never created. Nothing renames or creates YNAB categories.

## Out of scope
- Model calls (M3-3, M3-4), the pipeline (M3-11), the PROPOSED simplified list (M4).

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Ported guardrail tests pass, plus a case for each §3.2 skip.
- [ ] Test: P2P fixtures with no "Venmo" in the payee are skipped; a merchant containing a P2P-like word is not.
- [ ] Test: a rule needs unanimity and the minimum count; one dissenting label stops it; an out-of-list category stops it.
- [ ] Test: set-asides, internal, deleted, hidden, hidden-group and Credit Card Payments categories aren't candidates; a policy entry for a missing category warns.
- [ ] Test: `PayeeHistory` leaves out labels that aren't active candidates.
- [ ] Test: both hashes are order-independent and change when a name or description changes.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
